questions.question: Which of the following groups is a good conductor of heat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Steel, copper and aluminium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Conductor**: 

 
 
• A **substance **or **material **that **permits the flow of electricity **is known as an **electrical conductor**.
 
• When voltage **is provided**, **electrical charge carriers**, often electrons or ions, travel **effortlessly from atom to atom in a conductor**.
 
• **Materials made **of **metal **are common **electrical conductors**.
 
• On the **surface of conductors**, there is **an electric charge**.
 
• There are **four different kinds of conductors**: **semiconductors, resistors, excellent conductors, and non-conductors**.
 
• Some **examples of conductors**: **Silver, Gold, Copper, Aluminum, Mercury, Steel, Iron, and Seawater**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Semiconductor**:

 
 
• An **item made of silicon **that conducts electricity more **than an insulator **like **glass **but less **than a pure conductor **like **copper or aluminium is known as a semiconductor**.
 
• A **semiconductor **material has an **electrical conductivity **value falling **between that of a conductor and an insulator**.
 
• Its **resistivity falls **as **its temperature rises**; metals **behave in the opposite way**.
 
• Some **examples of semiconductors **are **silicon, germanium, gallium arsenide etc**.
 
 
 
• **Insulator**:
 
 
• **Any material **that **keeps energy **such as electricity, heat, or cold from easily transferring through is an insulator.
 
• A **substance that prevents the free flow of electrical current **is known as an **electrical insulator**.
 
• The **electrons in the insulator's atoms **are securely **bonded and immobile**.
 
• **Wood, plastic, rubber, and glass are good insulators**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Late 5th century, **most likely 477, **Bodhisattva Padmapani **from **cave 1 **at **Ajanta monastery **in **central India**.
 
• Early medieval India produced this **magnificent mural artwork**, which was **preserved inside the Buddhist rock-cut monastery of Ajanta**.
 
• **Ajanta**, a **Buddhist hamlet in Maharashtra**, **is close to Aurangabad**.
 
 
• This **was found by British soldiers **in a **horseshoe-shaped mountainside **where **29 caverns **have been **carved out**.
 
• There have been discovered **artwork in six of these caves**.
 
• The caverns come in **two different chaitya **and **vihara varieties**.
 
 
 
• **A Bodhisattva, **or someone on the **way to becoming a Buddha**, is **Padmapani.**
 
 
• He is **an iconic figure **in **Buddhist imagery **and the **personification of compassion**.
 
• He is **referred **to **as Padmapani**, or "**One who holds a lotus in his palm**," in Indian representations where he is **shown holding the Padma, or lotus flower**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pre-Buddha caves **are those that have **artwork **that was **produced prior to the Ajanta and Bagh Caves**. The **Jogimara cave**, which is located in **Sarguja in Chhattisgarh at Amarnath **close to the source of **the Narmada**, is an outstanding example of pre-Buddhist art.
 
• **One of the greatest prehistoric complexes **may be found at the **Bhimbetka site**, which also **houses the oldest known rock art in India**. The **mysterious primitive animal Dickinsonia **is among the **fossils from the Precambrian**, **hundreds of millions **of years before the **human era**, that may be found in the **Bhimbetka caves**.
 
• **It is renowned for both its structure temples**, such as the **Bhutanatha temples**, **Badami Shivalaya**, and **Jambulingesvara temple**, as well as its rock-cut monuments, such as the **Badami cave temples**. It is situated at the base of **a rough, red sandstone outcrop **that encircles Agastya lake, in a ravine.

questions.question: Rukmini Devi Arundale was a dancer of which of the following classical Indian dance forms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

• **Rukmini Devi's pedagogy **is what led to her **creation of dance**.
 
• She **practically changed how Bharatanatyam **and **Indian "traditional" dance are learned**, **taught**, and **performed throughout India **and the rest of the globe by building an institution, **"Kalakshetra," **around it.
 
 
 
• A **significant type of Indian classical dance **that has its **roots in Tamil Nadu is Bharatanatyam**. The dance **style is briefly described **as **"Bharata Natya" **in Someshwara III's Kannada work **Manasollasa**. Since **ancient times**, it has **flourished in the temples and courts of southern India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A significant ancient Indian classical dance**, known as **Odissi **in **older writings**, has its roots in the **temples of Odisha**, an eastern **coastal state of India**.
 
• **Music**, **dance**, **theatre**, and **other linked disciplines **are **all included in **the body of work known as **Sattriya dance **and theatre. These **artistic disciplines are extremely important to Assamese spiritual and social life**.
 
• A **significant type of classical Indian dance is kathakali**. The extremely **colourful make-up, costumes, and face masks **that the traditionally **male actor-dancers **wear set this **"story play" kind of art apart**. It is indigenous to Kerala's Malayalam-speaking southwest region, where Malayalis predominately practise and enjoy it.

questions.question: Who gave up the 'Kaiser-e-hind’ title in protest of Jallianwala massacre of 1919?
